brief_title: A Study to Compare Rosuvastatin/Ezetimibe and Rosuvastatin in Patients With Diabetes Mellitus and Hypercholesterolemia
official_title: A Multicenter Clinical Trial to Compare the Efficacy and Safety Between Rosuvastatin/Ezetimibe Combination and Monotherapy of Rosuvastatin in Patients With Diabetes Mellitus and Hypercholesterolemia
brief_summary: A Study to Compare Rosuvastatin/Ezetimibe Combination and Monotherapy in Patients with Diabetes Mellitus and Hypercholesterolemia.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects ≥ 19 or ≤ 75 years of age
* Subjects undergoing treatment for type 2 diabetes
* Subjects undergoing treatment of statin for hypercholesterolemia
* Fasting LDL-C ≤ 250mg/dL at the screening visit
* Fasting LDL-C ≥70mg/dL or ≤ 160mg/dL at the randomization visit
* Fasting TG\<500mg/dL

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with hypersensitivity reaction to Statin and Ezetimibe
* Subjects with severe kidney disease
* Subjects with HIV positive result at the screening
* Pregnant or breast-feeding subjects
* Subjects with taking any medication affecting level of LDL (Fenofibrate, Omega 3 fatty aicd etc.)
* Insulin-treated Subjects
* Other exclusions applied
